top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The 5 staff files reviewed did not have form 2912 included.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Activity plan did not include outdoor play.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §746.401(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required emergency telephone numbers posted.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 5 files evaluated did not contain proof of request for background check.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director's files is incomplete and does not have proof of orientation, DL/ID, pre-affidavit, nor an signed affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire Safety documentation was not available.
